text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's quite the scary face. Is something
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is! I've just heard tell of a student who
is
violating multiple school rules on a
regular basis!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Multiple school rules?! Are you saying there is a delinquent among our ranks?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Firsthand reports mention an
incredibly pale
student walking around
the school IN THE
MIDDLE OF THE
NIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! Leaving one's dorm after curfew is

STRICTLY prohibited!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's not all! This student has also been
sneaking
into other students' rooms and
climbing onto
their ceilings! INVADING
THEIR PRIVACY!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This cannot go on! We must see to it
that the
culprit is punished AT ONCE!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by these hands, we will guide this
delinquent
down the path to redemption
and righteousness!
Charge! Bakushiiin!
